name: Home Gym
description: Equipment-limited training. Substitution-aware programming with dumbbell and bodyweight alternatives when barbells are unavailable.
notes: When a barbell is unavailable, main-lift substitution is required (e.g. goblet squat, dumbbell press, dumbbell RDL). Programme effectiveness is preserved through dumbbell progressions and rep-range adjustment. Equipment constraints should drive exercise selection via SubstitutionModule (roadmap PR 16).

sources: Calatayud et al. 2015 dumbbell vs barbell EMG comparison
